log.text: First pass. Craigslist: 48 results with house/dogs/W-D filters; 10 kept after removing likely scams ($780–$1,350 'houses'), rooms for rent, duplicate posts, and listings outside Portland (Gresham, Beaverton, Clackamas, Vancouver, Cedar Mill, Amity). Zillow: 109 results; first 41 added (yard and dishwasher not yet checked; Zillow blocks automated reads of listing pages).
Added each listing's main photo (from the listing itself). All 10 Craigslist posts were still live.
Added availability dates: 35 of 47 listings state one (Zillow search results; Craigslist post details). The rest don't say.

Added Redfin: 41 new Portland houses (dogs allowed + in-unit W/D per Redfin; 19 outside city limits or units left out). Walk/Transit/Bike Scores (via Redfin) on 62 listings; 26 yard/dishwasher/W-D unknowns on existing listings confirmed from Redfin.
Refresh: 12 new houses (Craigslist 1, Zillow 8, Redfin 3); 6 no longer listed (2 Craigslist posts deleted, 4 off the market on Redfin).

Zillow pages 2–3 (Eric passed a bot check on page 3): 41 more new houses; 16 were already in the app from Craigslist/Redfin; 1 older Zillow listings no longer listed. Yard/dishwasher unconfirmed for new Zillow houses.

Refresh: 23 new houses (Craigslist 1, Redfin 8, Zillow 14); 19 no longer listed (Craigslist 1, Redfin 4, Zillow 14); 7446 SE 86th Ave back on the market at $2,200. Eric passed a Zillow bot check on page 2; 115 of 116 Zillow results read.

Refresh (now including townhouses and duplexes): 110 new homes (Craigslist 13, Redfin 50, Zillow 47; 25 houses, 44 townhouses, 41 duplexes/plexes); 35 existing homes updated with Redfin amenity details and Walk Scores; 5 no longer listed (Redfin 1, Zillow 4); back on the market: 6009 SW Taylors Ferry Rd, 4211 SE 91st Ave, 2235 N Emerson St. Eric passed a Zillow bot check on page 2; all 4 Zillow pages read.
Refresh: 10 new homes (Craigslist 2, Redfin 5, Zillow 3); 24 price changes; 10 no longer listed. No bot checks.
Refresh: 25 new homes (Craigslist 2, Redfin 9, Zillow 14); 11 price changes; 26 no longer listed. Eric passed a Zillow bot check on page 2.
Raised the minimum to 1.5 bathrooms: removed 150 listings with only 1 bath (117 active).

Removed 3 furnished homes (NE Portland "Gardener's Paradise", 26 SE 69th Ave, 4109 NE 19th Ave Unit B). Furnished listings are skipped from now on; 7554 NE Morris St stays because furnishing is optional.
